location: telemetry/exporter.py, Exporter.flush() -- the except block around the sink write
mechanism: The sink write is wrapped in `except Exception: pass`. The batch has already been detached from the buffer, so it is lost; nothing is logged, `dropped` is not incremented and `last_error` is never set, so `healthy` stays True and stats() reports a clean pipeline. A sink that is down or misconfigured discards every metric indefinitely with no signal anywhere, and flush() still reports the batch as written.
accepted_finding_forms: `except Exception: pass` swallows every sink failure -- the batch is lost with no log, no counter and no error recorded
the swallowed exception leaves last_error unset, so `healthy` stays True while the exporter is shipping nothing
flush returns len(batch) even when the write failed, reporting points as exported that were dropped
a total metrics outage is invisible because the failure path neither logs nor increments dropped
bare swallow of the sink error: the failure is neither surfaced, retried, nor counted
